paite: Huaiziak in noute sap a na omna uh toh kikhawm a khosa ding in kei Toupa a hentapa in ka hon ngen hi.
heading: Pumpi Kipum khatna
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

paite: Kingaihniamna leh migitna tengteng, kuhkalna toh, itna a kithuakzou chiat in,
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;

paite: lemna Kha a kipum khatna vom tinten ding in.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

paite: Ahon sapna pen lametna mun khat a sap na hih mah bang un pumpi khat leh Kha khat kia a-om hi.
english: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;

paite: Toupa khat, ginna khat, baptisma khat,
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

paite: bangkim Pathian leh Pa khat kia a om a; amah bangkim tung a om a, bangkim mu suak leh bangkim sung a om ahi.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.

paite: Himahleh Khrist thilpiak tehna bang zel in hehpihna i kiang chiat uah piak in a-om hi.
english: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

paite: "Huaiziak in ahi, tunglam a akahtouh lai in matte tampi api a, mihingte kiang ah leng thilpiakte apia,” achihna.
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.” Psalm 68:18

paite: Huchi in "Akahtou," chih lei mun nuainungpente bang a ahong suk masak phot keileh bangchi ahita dia le?
english: Now this, “He ascended,” what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

paite: Hong suk pen thil tengteng ahihdim theihna ding in, van tengteng tung pek a kahtoupa mah ahi.
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

paite: Huan khenkhatte sawltak hi ding in, khenkhatte zawlnei hi ding in, khenkhatte tanchinhoih gen ding in, khenkhatte pastor hi ding in, khenkhatte sinsaktu ding in apia hi.
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds or, pastors and teachers;

paite: Hiai tuh misiangthoute thopna ding, nasepna sepna ding, Khrist pumpi lamtouhna ding in.
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;

paite: Huai tuh ginna leh Pathian Ta theihna lam a thukituak a, piching a, Khrist taangchinna bang a i vek ua i om masiah a ding ahi.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;

paite: Huchi a mihingte diklouhna khemna bang a lepchiahpil a khem tawmtawm a om a, thuhilhna huih chiteng a alanglang a sep leh mutleng naupang i hih nawnlouhna ding un.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

paite: Itna a thutak gen a, bangkim a amah lupen, Khrist ngei a i khanlet zawkna ding uh ahi.
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;

paite: Amah a kipan pumpi tengteng kizopna chiteng sep ziak a lemtak a suktuah leh kizomkhawm a, hiang chih in sepdan ding bang asep chiang in pumpi akhang a itna ah amah-le-amah akilamtou hi.
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

paite: Tu in hiai Toupa ah ka hon theisak hi, Zentelte alungsim ginatlouhna uh pu a a-om bang un, na om nawn mahmah ding uh ahi kei hi.
heading: Khrist A Hinna Thak
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

paite: Amau alungtang uh khauh ziak a theihtheihna nei lou in Pathian hinna theihtheihna a pan posiah in a-om ua; atheihtheihna uh hihmial in a-om uhi.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;

paite: Akhenggawpta ua, siang lou chiteng hihna lam a huaiham in zautatna ah akipumpiak uhi.
english: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

paite: Himahleh nou zaw huchibang in Khrist thu na zil kei uhi!
english: But you did not learn Christ that way;

paite: Athu za a amah a thuhilh a om khin na hih peuhmah uleh, Jesu a thutak a om bang in,
english: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

paite: na pianken lui uh, na nidanglai hindan uh segawpsa suahkhia in,
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;

paite: na lungsim Kha uah athak in hong om unla,
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

paite: pianken thak, diktatna leh sianthouna a Pathian batpih a siam pen silh un.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

paite: Huchi in zuaugen tawpsan in, noumau inveng chiat kiang ah thudik gen un; khat-le-khat kihiangtuah chiat lah na hi ngal ua.
heading: Niteng Omdan Ding
english: Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

paite: Heh unla, khelh zaw khial kei un; na hehna uh ni in tumpih kei hen.
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Psalm 4:4 Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

paite: Diabol leng mun awn sam kei un.
english: neither give place to the devil.

paite: Guta in gu nawn kei hen; tasam kiang a piak ding aneihtheihna ding in, akhut a thil hoih sem in gim zaw hen.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

paite: Thusia peuhmah na kam ua kipan in pawt kei hen; akhawkdan bang zel a bawlhoih ding in thuhoih peuhmah pawt zaw hen, angaikhete a ding a hehpihna ahong hihtheihna ding in.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for building up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

paite: Huan Pathian Kha Siangthou hihlungkham kei un, tatna ni a ding in amah ah chiamteh na hi uhi.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

paite: Khaatna bang, thangpaihna bang, hehna bang, hanna bang, gensiatnate leh gitlouh tupna chiteng toh tawpsan in om hen.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.

paite: Huan kihehpihtuah chiat a lainatna nei in om unla, Pathian in Khrist a nou ahon ngaihdam bang in, noumau leng kingaidamtuah chiat un.
english: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
